ops.text: e. Client Ownership. Client retains all right, title and interest in and to Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property, Credit Data and all other data and materials provided by or on behalf of Client or generated through Client's use of the Interface, and nothing in this Agreement operates as an assignment or transfer of any ownership interest therein to TrueLink. All results of the Support Services and any other work product prepared specifically for Client are the property of Client, and TrueLink hereby assigns the same to Client; to the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded therein, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense such TrueLink Intellectual Property as part of such results and work product in the ordinary course of Client's business. No intellectual property is jointly owned under this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 2(d) confirms TrueLink's ownership of the Interface but the Agreement never reserves our side, so we have added a matching clause confirming that our content, IP and data remain ours, that results of the Support Services we pay for are ours, and that any TrueLink IP embedded in them is licensed to us on a perpetual, royalty-free basis. If TrueLink prefers, we can accept the fallback of TrueLink retaining its generic tools and know-how so long as we keep that perpetual, worldwide licence to use, modify and sublicense the results.
input.summary: Add a Client ownership subsection to Section 2 covering Client Content, Client IP and data, ownership of Support Services results, and a licence back to embedded TrueLink IP.
